concept.title: Understanding the Pull Request Lifecycle
concept.shortdesc: A pull request proposes changes from a working branch to the primary repository branch, enabling peer review and automated testing before integration.

conbody.p: In , pull requests serve as the primary mechanism for code and documentation review.
A pull request progresses through three primary stages:

ul.li: Draft State: Work in progress; automated checks run, but peer review is not required.
Open for Review: Ready for peer review and automated continuous integration status checks within the target SLA window.
Approved & Merged: Required reviewers approve changes, all automated status checks pass, and code merges into the target branch.
